content_parts.title: Introduction
content_parts.content: Check out what's new in the 2025 R4 release.

content_parts.title: Improvements
_jql: project = XT AND ((issuetype in (Epic, Story) AND 'X3 Release Note Status' in ('Communicated, Validated by PO/PM','Review Done') AND 'X3 Release Note Grouping' = 'Common' AND (statusCategory in (Done) OR status = 'Release Candidate') AND (resolution is EMPTY OR resolution in (Delivered, Done)) AND (component is EMPTY OR component not in componentMatch('^Addon*')) AND 'X3 Epic Type' not in (Internal, Research) AND 'X3 Epic Type' = Improvement) OR (issuetype = Bug AND 'X3 ReadMe Check' in ('To be communicated') AND 'X3 ReadMe Check' in ('Validated by PO') AND 'X3 Product Area' = 'Common' AND status in (Done) AND (component is EMPTY OR component not in componentMatch('^Addon*')) AND 'X3 Behaviour Change' = Yes)) AND fixVersion in x3ReleasesComponentsMatch("XT 2025 R4 (53.0.0)")

content_parts.content: On the Email domain sender page, an Email settings tab replaces the Reply-to tab. For a nominated package, you can add a sender email address for each type of sales and purchasing document issued from a specific company and site.

content_parts.title: Cannot save the stock details for a Stock transfer receipt

content_parts.content: You can save a Stock transfer receipt when the available stock level reduces to zero.

content_parts.title: Stock count defaults to a single site

content_parts.content: You can enter the selection criteria for a stock count that defaults to a specific site.

content_parts.title: Stock journal enquiry export does not include the Document column

content_parts.content: The Document column was added to the list of columns included in an export from the Stock journal inquiry main list.
To prevent an error from displaying, you can only select the Post action once.

content_parts.title: Purchase invoice and purchase credit memo Payments tab

content_parts.content: A Payments tab was added to the Purchase invoice and Purchase credit memo pages, and the Payment term and Due date fields were moved from the Information tab to the new tab. A link to the Accounts payable open item page is available on the tab if you do not use Sage Intacct.

content_parts.title: Stock transfer receipt date and the journal entry date are different

content_parts.content: To prevent discrepancies between a stock valuation and the general ledger, the stock journal date, which corresponds to the stock transfer receipt effective date, was aligned with the posting date.

content_parts.title: Work order and Production tracking are stuck at In progress status

content_parts.content: You can click the status of a work order to resync the status of a production tracking.

content_parts.title: A line cannot be deleted from a purchase invoice at Draft status

content_parts.content: You can delete a line on a purchase invoice or the purchase invoice if the status is Draft.

content_parts.content: Accounts payable payment tracking improves visibility of outstanding liabilities, enhances transparency, and simplifies accounts payables management. You can record payments on purchase invoices, offset payments against credit memos, and automatically mark invoices and credit memos as paid or partially paid. If you use Sage Intacct, this functionality is not available.

content_parts.content:
Shop Floor Control is integrated with Sage Distribution and Manufacturing Operations.
You can track the time operators dedicate to production tasks. You can also browse and monitor work orders to plan resources accordingly.

content_parts.content:
To enhance access to critical manufacturing data and improve decision-making, columns were added to the Manufacturing inquiries Production receipt, Material issue, Time tracking inquiry:

  • Work order name
  • Item name
  • Item ID

A Resource type column was added to the Time tracking line inquiry for greater data clarity and efficiency.

content_parts.title: Copy grid values to the clipboard

content_parts.content:
You can copy text from read-only and editable grid cells using your keyboard’s copy shortcut. You can then paste the copied text into emails, documents, and other text-based applications.
Prefixes and postfixes are not included.

content_parts.title: Active template of a factory report cannot be changed

content_parts.content: You can edit and save a factory report definition without error.
Customized column settings for a grid that is not a main list no longer reset to the default settings.

content_parts.title: Custom views can only be saved by an administrator user

content_parts.title: Main list custom views not available

content_parts.title: Font colors on forms do not match
